Impact Guns Boise also carries a wide range of ammunition, from handgun ammo to rifle ammo and even reloading supplies. If you're new to gun ownership or looking to upgrade your gear, their knowledgeable staff can help you find the right accessories, including scopes, sights, and holsters. This shop is perfect for Treasure Valley folks who enjoy outdoor activities like hunting and fishing. You'll appreciate their competitive prices and convenient online shopping experience. Whether you're a seasoned gun owner or just starting out, Impact Guns Boise has everything you need to stay safe and prepared in the great Idaho outdoors. Give them a call at (208) 321-1288 to learn more about their products and services.

Combat Sport Supply is your go-to shop for top-notch tactical gear in the Treasure Valley. Located at 3165 W Chinden Blvd, right here in Boise, these folks offer a wide range of firearms, training, ammunition, and accessories. Whether you're a seasoned shooter or just starting out, they've got what you need to complete your mission.

You'll find everything from airsoft replicas to survival gear and supplies at competitive prices. They even offer free shipping on orders over $100, which is perfect for Treasure Valley folks who like to stock up on gear. Their knowledgeable staff can help you navigate their vast selection, ensuring you get the right equipment for the job.

Combat Sport Supply is open Monday through Friday from 12 pm to 6 pm, Saturday from 10 am to 6 pm, and Sunday from 12 pm to 4 pm. They also offer other hours by appointment, so don't hesitate to reach out if you need something specific. Treasure Valley shooters know that Combat Sport Supply has got their backs when it comes to gear and training. Swing by, say hello, and get your gear – they'll take care of the rest.

Call (208) 336-1927 or visit them in person at 3165 W Chinden Blvd, Boise, ID 83714.
